excursions.description:
Bandaranaike International Airport at Katunayake is a starting point for arrival and departure transfers. Plan a direct journey to your hotel or discuss an optional stop when your flight times allow.

## Things to see and do

Agree your meeting point and contact method before arrival. Share your flight number so the transfer can be planned around your scheduled landing. Negombo or Colombo sightseeing can be discussed as a separate addition rather than assumed to be included.

## Suggested visit

For arrivals, allow time for immigration, baggage collection and meeting your driver before continuing to the agreed address. For departures, confirm a pick-up that allows for traffic and the check-in time recommended by your airline.

## When to visit

Transfers should be planned around the flight, not a fixed sightseeing timetable. Tell us about late-night arrivals, early departures and any changes to your schedule.

## Plan your transfer

Tell us your pick-up and drop-off points, travel date, passenger count, luggage and preferred stops. Mention children, mobility needs or a flight connection so the route and vehicle can be discussed before you confirm. Journey time depends on your starting point, traffic and agreed stops.

## Booking details

Request a personalised quote for the agreed route. The final confirmation will specify transport arrangements and inclusions. Entrance tickets, specialist guides, meals, accommodation, boat trips, safari jeeps and other activities are separate unless explicitly included. Confirm any cancellation or schedule-change terms before booking.

Explore Colombo with a flexible city visit combining busy streets, waterfront views and time to experience the commercial capital at your own pace.

## Things to see and do

Choose a walk at Galle Face Green, time around the Dutch Hospital precinct or a visit to Pettah. Gangaramaya Temple, the National Museum and Lotus Tower can be discussed according to your interests; admission and opening arrangements should be checked for your date.

## Suggested visit

Begin at your hotel or agreed pick-up point, then combine a few nearby sights rather than rushing across the whole city. Allow time for lunch or shopping at your own expense and finish at the agreed drop-off location.

## When to visit

Start earlier for walking and plan indoor breaks during the hottest part of the day. Rain and city traffic can change the order of stops, so keep some flexibility.

Kandy brings together living religious traditions, a lakeside setting and the green hills of the central region. Build a visit around culture, gardens or a relaxed walk.

## Things to see and do

Discuss a visit to the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and a walk beside Kandy Lake. The Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya can be added if time permits. A cultural performance is optional and should be confirmed separately.

## Suggested visit

Start with the temple or gardens according to opening arrangements, take a break for lunch at your own expense, then allow time for the lake or another agreed stop. Keep the number of visits realistic for your starting point.

## When to visit

Allow extra time for traffic and busy worship periods. Choose comfortable footwear for walking and bring a light rain layer. At religious sites, follow local dress and photography guidance.

Discover Galle through a walk around its historic fort, sea-facing ramparts and streets lined with shops and places to pause. The route can be adapted to your pace.

## Things to see and do

Explore the fort streets, lighthouse surroundings and accessible sections of the ramparts. Discuss a museum or shopping stop if it interests you. A nearby beach visit can be arranged separately when the route and available time allow.

## Suggested visit

Travel to Galle from the agreed pick-up point, spend time exploring the fort on foot, and pause for refreshments or lunch at your own expense. Confirm any coastal stops before the return or onward transfer.

## When to visit

Choose cooler hours for walking where possible and carry sun protection. Rain can make stone surfaces slippery. Keep away from unprotected rampart edges and follow any local access restrictions.

Ella offers hill-country scenery, walking routes and a relaxed town base. Choose a manageable combination of viewpoints and stops to suit your fitness and the time available.

## Things to see and do

Discuss Little Adam's Peak, a viewpoint near the Nine Arch Bridge or a stop at Ravana Falls. A tea-estate visit may also be possible by arrangement. Train sightings, factory access and clear mountain views are not guaranteed.

## Suggested visit

Begin with the most active walk while you are fresh, then take a break before another viewpoint or town stop. Agree where the driver will wait and whether any sections require a local walking guide.

## When to visit

Hill-country weather can change quickly; mornings can be useful for walking but visibility varies. Wear shoes with grip and avoid exposed or slippery paths in poor conditions. View the railway from safe designated areas.

Nuwara Eliya is a cool-climate hill-country town surrounded by tea-growing landscapes. Plan a gentle visit combining town sights, gardens and an optional estate experience.

Choose time around Gregory Lake, a walk in Victoria Park or a visit to a tea estate and factory that accepts visitors. Factory tours, tastings and paid lake activities need to be confirmed with the relevant operator.

## Suggested visit

Travel through the hills to the agreed first stop, allow time for a town or garden walk, then discuss a tea visit and a meal at your own expense. Avoid packing long mountain transfers and too many activities into one day.

## When to visit

Bring layers and a rain jacket for cool or wet weather. Check the forecast before planning viewpoint stops; mist can limit views and winding roads can slow the journey.

Sigiriya combines an ancient rock fortress with gardens and wide views across the surrounding landscape. Plan enough time to enjoy the site rather than treating it as a quick photo stop.

## Things to see and do

Explore the approach gardens and, if suitable for your fitness, climb the steps towards the upper site. The museum can be discussed as part of the visit. A Dambulla stop is optional and should be agreed as an additional visit.

## Suggested visit

Aim to reach the site early, allow time for the gardens and climb, then take a rest and meal break at your own expense. Confirm whether a licensed site guide is wanted and where you will meet the driver afterwards.

## When to visit

Choose cooler hours where possible and check conditions on the day. The climb involves many steps and exposed sections; tell us about mobility needs before booking. Carry water and follow site instructions.

Anuradhapura combines ancient monuments with active places of worship. A thoughtful route lets you experience the sacred city while allowing time for the distances between sites.

Discuss visits to Ruwanwelisaya, the Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi precinct and selected archaeological remains. Choose the sites that matter most to you rather than assuming every monument can fit into one short visit.

## Suggested visit

Start with the agreed sacred or archaeological sites, travel between the more distant stops by vehicle and allow breaks in the shade. A local guide can be discussed separately if you would like more historical interpretation.

## When to visit

Plan walks for cooler hours and bring sun protection. Follow temple dress rules and remove footwear where required. Bare stone and sand can become hot, so consider suitable socks where permitted.

Polonnaruwa offers a journey through the remains of an ancient royal city. Its archaeological sites reward a paced visit with time to look closely at stonework and sculpture.

## Things to see and do

Discuss the Royal Palace remains, the Vatadage area and Gal Vihara. A stop near Parakrama Samudra may be added to the agreed route. Confirm entry arrangements and whether you want a separate site guide.

## Suggested visit

Begin with a few key archaeological stops, take a break from the heat and continue to the remaining sites that suit your pace. The driver can help link the separate areas without assuming the entire visit is a walking tour.

## When to visit

Visit during cooler hours where practical. Carry drinking water and follow the instructions at religious monuments, including dress and footwear requirements. Respect barriers around fragile structures and sculptures.

Mirissa is a south-coast destination for beach time, ocean views and optional marine excursions. Build your visit around the shoreline or discuss a separately arranged boat trip.

Relax on the beach or discuss a visit to Coconut Tree Hill when access and conditions permit. Whale watching is an optional activity with a suitable operator; departures depend on sea conditions and wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed.

## Suggested visit

For a coastal visit, combine beach time and a viewpoint with a meal at your own expense. If booking a boat trip, confirm its meeting point, expected return and transfer plan before adding other activities.

## When to visit

Check local sea and weather conditions before swimming or boating. Follow the boat operator's safety guidance, give wildlife space and avoid approaching cliff edges or exposed rocks at viewpoints.

Spend time at the beach and discuss snorkelling, a glass-bottom boat outing or surfing with a suitable local operator. Conditions, experience requirements and equipment should be confirmed before booking an activity.

## Suggested visit

Agree the beach or activity meeting point, allow time to change and rest, then include a lunch stop at your own expense. A further coastal stop can be discussed if it fits the transfer route.

## When to visit

Sea conditions vary by day and location. Seek local advice before entering the water and follow operator guidance. Do not touch coral, feed turtles or disturb marine life; use shore access responsibly.

Discuss Koneswaram Temple and the Swami Rock area, then consider time at Uppuveli or Nilaveli. A Pigeon Island outing is a separate activity requiring suitable sea conditions, entry arrangements and an appropriate boat operator.

Start with the agreed cultural stop, take a meal break at your own expense and continue to your selected beach. Keep boat excursions separate from a tightly timed transfer, especially when travelling from another region.

## When to visit

Check sea conditions before planning swimming or boat travel. Follow temple dress rules and local access guidance. A long journey to the east coast may be better planned with an overnight stay.

## Suggested visit

Travel to your agreed beach or hotel drop-off, allow unhurried time by the coast and take a meal break at your own expense. For longer transfers, consider an overnight stay rather than a rushed same-day return.

Tissamaharama is a base for exploring the surrounding lakes and arranging a visit to Yala. Combine a gentle town stay with an optional safari planned around park arrangements.

## Things to see and do

Discuss a lakeside stop near Tissa Wewa or a visit to the Tissamaharama temple area. A Yala safari is a separate activity using a suitable safari jeep and operator; it is not included automatically in a road transfer.

## Suggested visit

For a safari, agree the jeep meeting point and timing before arranging your hotel transfer. Leave time to rest afterwards. Alternatively, keep the visit focused on the town and lakes with a meal stop at your own expense.

## When to visit

Confirm park access, permits and operating arrangements for your date before booking a safari. Wildlife is unpredictable and sightings are never guaranteed. Follow the jeep operator's and park staff's instructions.

Negombo is a coastal town with a lagoon, working fishing areas and places to pause before or after a flight. Choose a short local visit or a more relaxed beach stay.

Discuss the lagoon surroundings, a local market visit or time by the beach. A boat outing is optional and should be arranged with an appropriate operator. Markets are working spaces, so visit considerately and ask before photographing people.

## Suggested visit

Start at your hotel or agreed pick-up point, combine a few nearby stops and allow a meal break at your own expense. If visiting around a flight, make the airport transfer the priority and leave a suitable time buffer.

## When to visit

Plan market visits around local activity rather than assuming a fixed display or timetable. Check weather and water conditions before a boat outing and follow the operator's safety guidance.
